name: The Standard
concept: The supplied case itself becomes an open typographic proof wall; a large, explicitly illustrative payout figure sets the visual hierarchy.
silhouette: full-width two-line heading above six unboxed editorial statements with one oversized figure
focal_reason: Milestone payouts, without diminishing the other five
interaction: Deliberately static reading surface; a thin line and background respond to pointer hover. All content is visible without JavaScript.
safety: ₹4.2L and Reply under 2m are labelled illustrative beside their claims; no record, transaction or performance history is implied.
